answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 39457 Country: India Title: What is the view of Muftis about a very serious matter of using cloned animal and plant Question: What is the view of Muftis about a very serious matter of using cloned animal and plant? Is it halal or not, please reply with complete details. Answer ID: 39457 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 994/604/L=1433) If the sperm of halal animal was used to clone the animal then that animal shall be considered halal, otherwise haram. And if such tree was grown by clone whose fruit is eaten then its fruits shall be termed as halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
